parameters{

	tblEndurCommoditiesTradeEventsAmendedStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

		name as string,
		short_name as string,
		internal_external as string,

		reference as string,

	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> DailyTradeEventsReportAmended	source(output(
		filename as string

DailyTradeEventsReportAmended derive(FileName = toString($sFilename),
		LoadDate_drv = toString(currentTimestamp())) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of event_date} = event_date,
		{Copy of deal_tracking_num} = deal_tracking_num,
		{Copy of trader_name} = trader_name) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion,CheckarchivetbltopreventdupesLKPTABLE lookup(DerivedColumn@FileName == CheckarchivetbltopreventdupesLKPTABLE@filename,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Checkarchivetbltopreventdupes
Checkarchivetbltopreventdupes filter(!isMatch()) ~> Checkarchivetbltopreventdupes0
Checkarchivetbltopreventdupes0 sink(input(
		trade_event_category as string,
		toolset as string,
		prior_tran as string,
		deal_tracking_num as string,
		trade_time as string,
		booked_to_new_by as string,
		FileName as string,
		new_validated_by as string,
		amend_by as string,
		File_LoadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		type_of_event as string,
		marketer_name as string,
		insType as string,
		event_date as string,
		trader_name as string,
		executed_by as string,
		Internal_External as string,
		comments as string,
		Reference as string,
		amend_reason as string,
		last_name as string,
		Title as string,
		ReasonCode as string,
		latest_validated_by as string,
		name as string,
		short_name as string,
		action_interval_days as string,
		current_tran as string,
		tran_num as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(

		toolset,
		prior_tran,
		deal_tracking_num,
		trade_time,
		booked_to_new_by,
		FileName,
